pattern: # One rule per line. pattern = case-insensitive regex on "payee + memo + counterparty IBAN". First match wins
# so put specific rules above generic ones. Transfers between your own accounts are detected
# by IBAN automatically; only add Transfer rules for cases without an IBAN (card settlement).
# transfer_account = the account id from accounts.csv on the other side of that transfer.
# --- transfers without IBAN (account ids from your accounts.csv)
# --- currency exchanges inside one account (Revolut) and fees
# --- Trade Republic (memo starts with the type)
# --- fallback: the bank's own category (some parsers put it into the memo as "kat:...").
# Keep these last so your own rules win. "Familie & Freunde"
# and "Einkünfte" are left out on purpose: check those yourself.
# --- fallback: card merchant category codes (Trade Republic puts them into the memo as "mcc:NNNN")
